topic: Modern JavaScript, APIs, and Asynchronous Programming
learningObjectives: Use modern JavaScript features such as arrow functions, destructuring, and modules.
Explain asynchronous execution using promises and async/await.
Consume a REST API and process its response in a web application.

activities.title: Modern JavaScript Explorer
activities.instruction: Identify the modern JavaScript feature being used in each example.

content.concept: Modern JavaScript includes features such as arrow functions, destructuring, spread syntax, and modules that make code more expressive and reusable.

activities.title: Async Execution Flow
activities.instruction: Arrange the steps of an async/await operation.

content.concept: Promises represent future results, while async and await provide a readable way to pause an async function until a Promise settles.

activities.title: Fetch Request Builder
activities.instruction: Construct a basic fetch request and response-handling flow.

content.concept: The Fetch API allows browser JavaScript to send HTTP requests and asynchronously process server responses.

activities.title: API Response Anatomy
activities.instruction: Explore the important parts of an API response.

content.concept: An API response commonly contains a status code, headers, and a body such as JSON data that the frontend can process.
